meta.title: Zenbree · Describe your ideal customer, Zenbree finds who to contact
meta.description: Tell the chat who you want to reach: up to 100 credits a search starts at once; above that the agent shows you the plan and the most it can cost, and you approve it. Then it delivers people with a verified email and the source of every data point. The plan is free, you only pay for delivered rows.

unsubscribe.doneBody: {email} is on {sender}'s exclusion list. Scheduled messages have been cancelled. Nothing else to do.

unsubscribe.alreadyBodyUndated: {email} gets no more emails from {sender}. If another message reached you, just reply «no grazie»: we read it and block that one too.
unsubscribe.failed: Something went wrong. Try again, or reply «no grazie» to the email.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: It may be incomplete (this happens when the email is forwarded or the link wraps onto a new line). To stop receiving messages, just reply «no grazie» to the email: it always works.
